text:
alyssa: quick sanity check — i ran a cross-region sweep this morning for model bring-up (13B, 70B) across eu-west-1 and us-east-1 on A100/H100. comparing q8_0 vs q4_k_m and a triton kernel pass. high-level: eu-west shows worse tail for 70B on default cuda kernels; a100 throughput looks more predictable but saturates earlier at higher concurrency.

cheng: can you paste the raw numbers/configs? which driver/kernel versions and batch sizes?

alyssa: sure — ran with runtime:v2.3.1, cuda 12.2, pytorch 2.2, triton 2.8. batch_size=1, dynamic batching enabled, continuous_kv_cache on. quick table:

```
model | region   | gpu  | quant    | kernel    | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | tokens/s/GPU | suggested_concurrency
13B   | us-east  | A100 | q8_0     | cuda      | 45      | 120     | 1800         | 48
13B   | eu-west  | H100 | q4_k_m   | cuda      | 40      | 160     | 1600         | 36
70B   | us-east  | H100 | q8_0     | cuda      | 120     | 340     | 800          | 16
70B   | eu-west  | H100 | q8_0     | triton    | 110     | 380     | 720          | 12
```

max: looks like triton gave p50 wins on 70B but p95 regressed — probably due to small-batch kernel tail. did you try `kernel=auto`? sometimes runtime picks a mixed kernel set that balances tail.

alyssa: i did a quick auto run — it picked cuda for most layers, triton for some fused matmuls; numbers were between the two but still ~15% worse p95 in eu-west. hypothesis: network hop + NVLink topology in that eu-west host pool increases jitter at high KV cache churn.

srini: for Dedicated sizing i'd anchor to p95 targets. propose we aim for max_concurrency that keeps p95 <= SLA_p95 * 1.1 and GPU util ~65-75%. for these numbers that gives: 13B -> 40 per A100 in us-east; 13B -> 30 per H100 in eu-west (q4_k_m only for non-prod). reserve 20% warm spare replicas for autoscale headroom.

jess: fwiw evals show q4_k_m has measurable generation quality drop on our safety + factuality suite for 13B (delta BLEU/ROUGE-ish). can't ship q4_k_m for prod 13B until eval rollback risk is mitigated. we can still use it for cost sims and staging.

autoscale-bot: Autoscale sim complete. Inputs: 99th traffic trace (last 7d), concurrency targets from srini. Result: us-east cluster requires 42 A100 replicas to maintain p95 SLO under peak; eu-west H100 pool requires 16 replicas with 20% warm spare -> 20 total. estimated monthly reserved commit delta ~ +12%.

max: next step for perf team: run kernel probe with `--kernel triton --warmup 60s --ban-small-batches` and collect p95/p99 tails + CPU->GPU transfer histograms. also capture nvlink stats on eu-west hosts.

alyssa: action items: 1) perf team run max's probe (max) 2) ml evals gate on q4_k_m (jess) 3) infra sim adjust autoscale policy to 20% warm spare and add region-specific kernel overrides (cheng) 4) i'll open canary rollout PR for 70B on us-east with triton opt (start with 5% traffic).

cheng: noted. i'll also add a dashboard tile for inter-region p95 diff and attach the raw bench CSV here: https://console.redwood/bench/1799012345 (temp link).

alyssa: thanks — tagging follow-ups in the perf board. @autoscale-bot please re-run sim after kernel probe results. :thumbsup:
